description:
Opportunity amount with an unknown currency code is saved but not shown in the app

## Bug Description

When I create an opportunity over the API with a currency code that does not exist, for example `XYZ`, the API accepts it and stores the code as sent. On the record page the Amount field then looks empty, as if the deal had no value. The same deal in EUR shows "€12.5k".

1. `POST /rest/opportunities` with `{"name": "Deal in XYZ", "amount": {"amountMicros": 12500000000, "currencyCode": "XYZ"}}`
2. Open the opportunity in the app

| Currency `XYZ` | Currency `EUR` |
|---|---|
| ![Deal in XYZ: the Amount field looks empty](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nikolay-Chillev/twenty-qa/80a4f2d5aca6be52b47e04d396f3913c7e75019b/docs/images/finding-30-xyz.png) | ![The same deal in EUR: €12.5k](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nikolay-Chillev/twenty-qa/80a4f2d5aca6be52b47e04d396f
